body:
Redline round 3

Reviewed only the fix diff from round 2 (da5b577..aaebc2b).

The round 2 fix changes the id check in setup's `ask_rules_fault` from `^...$` to `\A...\z`. Setup now accepts and refuses ids by the same rule as the guard's `fullmatch` and the workflow's `/^...$/`. Running jq directly showed that `"a\n"` was accepted before and is refused now, while `a` and `a-1` are still accepted and `Ab`, `"\na"` and `"a\nb"` are still refused. The new setup-test cases cover both the refused newline id and the accepted id with a digit and a hyphen. The standards bullets record the lesson accurately. This round has no findings.

No findings.
